state.task: Split an already discussed upload integrity and recovery plan into actionable LOCAL issue specifications. Do not implement business code or interview the user again.
confirmed_requirements: Preserve all effective information, retain original files and trace sources. Layout reproduction is unnecessary.
First validate TXT and simple text PDFs. Scanned, mixed and unverified complex PDFs remain awaiting verification; OCR is later.
Unknown or failed completeness must prevent activation; the last valid version stays usable.
Measure upload start to fully verified searchable content, with transfer, queue, parse, verify, chunk, embed and index timings.
Conservative traceable cleaning; retain footnotes, marginal notes and suspected headers unless independent evidence proves redundancy.
Select installed compatible parsers by file type; PDF options do not affect TXT. Retry only bounded transient failures.
Independent synthetic truth then representative local documents; do not send real file contents to Jev.
Baseline before setting p50/p95 and completion targets. No workload SLA has been agreed.
Resume the same persisted document and task, reuse only verified artifacts with matching source hash and stage configuration versions.
Keep other supported formats; reject empty, oversized and mismatched inputs; evaluate only PDF/TXT.
Deliver core parsing, integrity and recovery in batch one; frontend scheduling, cancellation and progress in batch two.
observed_failures: TXT inherited a PDF-only parser override; a missing executable was retried four times.
PDF normalization dropped coverage warnings; mixed PDFs could be accepted with only one extracted page.
Column reading order and table/header preservation failed synthetic checks.
Stage completion currently permits activation without an independent completeness gate.
Raw file and SHA256 exist, but extracted artifact provenance is not persisted.
Frontend probes confirmed excess concurrency, preflight races, falsely successful cancellation, late polling overwrite and ETA origin resets.
state.test_surfaces: Prefer existing file upload, status and resume HTTP interfaces plus the ingestion lifecycle. Add parser/artifact tests only where independent truth cannot be checked through those surfaces. Browser tests belong to batch two.

alternatives.six_phases: Six larger tickets: baseline; routing/retry; extraction/cleaning/chunking; gate/index/recovery; core acceptance; all frontend work. Fewer shared-contract handoffs, but large tickets mix distinct failures and acceptance criteria.
alternatives.twenty_four: Twenty-four narrower tickets by separate schema, adapter, storage, status/API, validator and frontend component edits. Easier small diffs, but many tickets lack independently observable behavior and require repeated shared contract changes.

state.scope_constraints: One repository with existing adapters, lifecycle and local ready-for-agent labels. No GitHub publication, deployment, arbitrary PDF completeness promises, per-file AI decisions or new core framework. Plan labels do not imply dependencies complete or authorization to implement.

task_granularity.instructions: Choose the task granularity that best balances independently observable acceptance, review size, dependency overhead and the user's fixed two-batch scope. Evaluate all options from the evidence; do not infer completion from ticket labels.

criteria.six_phases: Use the six larger tickets described in state.alternatives.six_phases.
criteria.sixteen_behavior_tickets: Use the sixteen behavior and acceptance packages in state.candidate_16, defining shared contracts once and recording real dependencies.
criteria.twenty_four_layer_tickets: Use the twenty-four narrower technical-layer tickets described in state.alternatives.twenty_four.

integrity_and_index_boundary.instructions: Given an activation guard that must require both content integrity and verified searchable indexing, which ticket boundary best permits independent failure reproduction and shared activation correctness?

criteria.separate_shared_guard: Separate content-integrity lifecycle and indexed visibility verification tickets, define a shared verification contract in the former, and prohibit activation until both proofs exist.
criteria.single_large_gate_ticket: Merge content-integrity checks, index manifest/visibility and lifecycle activation into a single ticket to minimize changes to the guard.
criteria.index_success_suffices: Treat successful index writes as enough evidence of completeness and activation.

baseline_order.instructions: For the user's goal of measuring speed and complete success rate without relaxing integrity, when should independent-truth fixtures and a before-fix baseline be established?

criteria.before_behavior_changes: Establish an independent oracle and record an isolated current baseline first. Known failures are recorded observations, not reasons to weaken the oracle. Repeat the same samples after implementation.
criteria.after_all_fixes: Build fixtures and gather the first baseline only after routing, cleaning, activation and recovery changes.
criteria.reuse_old_test_passes: Use historical unit-test pass ratios and model confidence as the completion-rate baseline.
